web_stubs.intro_desc: Multica ships experimental features as opt-in Labs. The desktop app is where they live today; this page lists what is available so you know what to enable after installing Multica Desktop.
web_stubs.web_only_desc: This experimental surface is rendered by the desktop app's bundled runtime (Electron + native Postgres + lab sandbox). It is not reachable from the web app because the runtime, IPC bridge, and per-workspace subprocesses are desktop-only. Install Multica Desktop to use this lab.
web_stubs.desc_claude_lab: Multi-agent research workspace. Plan, chat, run code, search literature, and forecast — all in one tab.
web_stubs.desc_pythia: Multi-perspective forecasting engine. Streams structured predictions (scenario, probability, confidence) for issues and watchlist symbols.
web_stubs.desc_mythos: Agent swarm with two modes: `sole` (the swarm owns the issue end-to-end) and `enhancer` (the swarm preludes + supervises your chosen assignee).
web_stubs.desc_llm_wiki_bridge: Local stdio bridge for LLM Wiki. Streams wiki files / search / status to your editor or agent runtime over MCP-style verbs.
web_stubs.desc_code_canvas: Interactive canvas for prototyping, sketching code, and exploring agent-generated snippets in a side-by-side editor.
web_stubs.desc_swarm_topology: Self-organising multi-agent topology. A leader authors role-agents + skills + a coordinating squad, then walks a 5-phase machine (research → design → implement → review → done).
web_stubs.desc_plugin: User-installed lab plugin. Manifest-driven tabs (chat / artifacts / table / iframe / code / settings) on top of a per-plugin inline runtime.

code_canvas.title: Code Canvas
code_canvas.intro: Render a code snippet into a self-contained, syntax-highlighted canvas view. The lab runs a local stdlib-only service — your code never leaves the machine.
code_canvas.input_placeholder: Paste a code snippet to render…
code_canvas.empty_hint: Enter code above and click Render — the HTML canvas view appears here.
code_canvas.not_enabled_desc: Open Settings → Labs and enable the code_canvas flag to render code into canvas views here.

semantica.title: Semantica Explorer
semantica.not_enabled_desc: Open Settings → Labs and enable the Semantica Knowledge Graph flag to use the explorer.
